# Pharus

> Pharus is inventory management software for consumer goods (CPG) brands. It keeps one ledger of inventory, orders and payments across a brand's sales channels, warehouses and accounting system, drafts the routine work, and brings each action to the operator to approve. Nothing posts without approval.

## What Pharus does

- Tracks inventory across storefronts, marketplaces, warehouses and third-party logistics providers (3PLs)
- Drafts sales orders, purchase orders, production and work orders, transfers, payment matches and journal entries from what it sees in connected systems
- Flags problems before they cost money: a stockout before the next production run, an order that will ship short, stock in the wrong warehouse, a campaign selling past replenishment
- Reports contribution margin by customer, channel and SKU

## Who it is for

Consumer goods brands that resell finished goods, manufacture or convert their own product, or sell wholesale to retailers and distributors.

## What it connects to

Examples include Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, Google Ads, QuickBooks, EDI, email, and 3PLs such as ShipVine, ShipHero, Logiwa, ShipBob and RJW Edge.

## Plans and pricing

Three plans, set by business model: Standard (resellers), Pro (manufacturers) and Custom (wholesale, EDI and custom workflows). Pricing depends on what Pharus connects to, not on orders, users or revenue, and is quoted in a 30-minute working session on the brand's own data.
